Starting WCB physio at Delta

  1. Report your injury to WorkSafeBC online or through Teleclaim (1.888.967.5377).
  2. Book a WCB Physio Initial Session at Delta online or call (604) 516-8505.
  3. Bring your 8-digit claim number if you have it.

FAQ

Questions about WCB physio at Delta

Is Synergy Rehab Delta open evenings and weekends?

Yes. We are open 7 days a week, and our latest closing time is 8:30 PM. Full hours: Mon to Fri 7:30 AM to 8:30 PM; Sat to Sun 8 AM to 4 PM.

Can I book WCB massage therapy at Delta?

Not online at Delta right now. The nearest clinic that books WCB massage online is Nordel, about 4.2 km away. WorkSafeBC massage needs a doctor’s referral and an accepted claim.

Where do I park at Delta?

Staff to confirm: Parking: where to park, cost, time limits

What if Delta has no time that works for me?

Our nearest clinics also book WCB physio online: Nordel (about 4.2 km) and Strawberry Hill (about 4.3 km). You can see every clinic on our WorkSafeBC physiotherapy page.
